risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant exposure to interest rate risk: 78% of consolidated debt is fixed rate, 15% is floating rate with interest rate caps, and 7% is floating rate without caps. Interest rate fluctuations may impact floating rate debt and increase interest expenses, although short maturities limit long-term risk.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates internationally and is exposed to foreign exchange rate fluctuations in connection with its overseas operations. The company has implemented hedging instruments to mitigate this risk, but it remains present due to the nature of its assets and international operations.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk is low due to the quality of debt and the company's ability to meet its obligations. Debt is generally secured by quality real estate assets.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory risk is low due to the company's compliance with regulations in force in the jurisdictions where it operates.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must maintain sufficient liquidity to meet its short-term obligations and finance its operations. The need for liquidity for debt repayment and investments represents moderate exposure.

ai_positioning.summary: Kennedy-Wilson does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual 10-K report. Information focuses on financial aspects, real estate investment strategies, asset management, and market risks.
